research_brief.central_hypothesis: A non-circular uniform tail theorem could turn an RH-equivalent Li-positivity framework into an auditable proof route; absent such a theorem, the finite layer remains finite.
alternative_explanations: a candidate bridge is only analogy
the tail bound is conditional or non-uniform
a formal model omits an intended analytic hypothesis
falsification_conditions: any proof-obligation edge is GAP or CONDITIONAL
finite data are used to infer an unbounded statement
the final theorem assumes RH or an equivalent condition

acceptance_rule: RH may be labeled a candidate proof only when O1 through O6 are proved with explicit hypotheses and independently checked; no finite certificate or conditional result may receive that label.
